metadata.description: Marketplace hosting the OKF Knowledge Base plugin.

plugins.name: okf-knowledge-base
plugins.description: Agent-operated knowledge base on the Open Knowledge Format v0.2, run as a Karpathy-style LLM wiki: bootstrap a KB with automatic or agent-driven capture, initialize domains, ingest sources (auto-routed by domain description), search, lint, and consolidate. A bundled stdlib-only Python MCP server does the deterministic work (requires python3 3.11+).
